# Your privacy, completely protected

Detect and redact names, emails, IDs, phone numbers, and more. Prepare your documents before sending them to ChatGPT or Claude.

### Your information is never stored

The text you enter is processed directly via encrypted HTTPS. We do not store, log, or analyze any content you enter into this tool. When you close the tab, everything disappears.

### Save time with a Custom Dictionary

Log in or sign up to securely save internal project names, client brands, or custom codes. Your masking rules sync to the cloud, so you never have to repeat the process.

Cloud Mode Privacy: Processed via our paid API tier. Your data is never used to train AI models. However, our subprocessor (Google) temporarily logs payloads for automated safety and abuse monitoring. For strict NDAs or PHI, please use the Local Engine.

### Hybrid Local Engine

Cross-references inputs against thousands of regional names instantly while matching complex mathematical patterns for international IDs.

### Zero Storage

There is no database, logs, or analytics capturing your text. We comply with strict data protection standards. Once processed, your data is immediately discarded.

### 100% Offline Capable

For maximum privacy with extremely sensitive data, our proprietary engine anonymizes directly on your device without any external API calls.
